method: Read-only actual adapter/tests and installed rc3 middleware source. No native/HTTP test, dependency mutation or service execution.

findings.issue: Declared oversize is rejected before sole-active acquisition; response Connection:close is set but handler returns without awaiting closure.
findings.repair: Admit before declared validation and route413 through same timed try/catch/finally as streamed overflow.

findings.issue: Stream overflow uses destroyOnReturn:false; catch replies413 then finally releases active without awaiting actual connection close. Connection:close improves actual cleanup but does not bind slot lifetime.
findings.repair: Flush only fixed bounded error, close/destroy connection, await socket close under admitted owner; no unbounded body drain.

findings.issue: No own request deadline: incomplete below-cap upload can indefinitely occupy adapter until external server limits intervene; completed request stalled in native await has no response deadline. Existing test incorrectly conflates any timer with detached Promise.race.
findings.repair: One admitted request timer (10s aligned with transport) marks aborted and destroys incoming/response socket, while original body/native await is still owned. After native settlement alive guards prohibit later queries/encoding/results; finally clears timer/listeners and releases active. Never Promise.race-release pending native work or add native retries.

nativeAwaitLimit: Current getBlock/getBlockData/inspector methods expose promises without supported cancellation parameters here. A timer can stop serving and prevent subsequent work, not forcibly settle an in-progress native call. Preserve active until that call settles; a hung call keeps adapter busy fail-closed. External existing node/process supervisor owns eventual recovery. Do not claim10s native CPU/work completion or introduce another node lifecycle.

officialRegistration.admin: Separate adminServices119–125/adminMiddlewares111–118; must remain unchanged and never receive compact middleware.
officialRegistration.ordering: SafeJsonRpcServer.getApp: compress143, jsonResponse146,CORS150–171,extraMiddlewares173–175,exceptionHandler176,bodyParser177–182. Add after preserved main telemetry/propagation/versioning, before parser through official middlewares option.
officialRegistration.receiver: register_node_rpc_handlers.js:24–28 binds services.aztec=[actual node,AztecNodeApiSchema], node alias same tuple. Capture that actual first element exactly once after startup; bind methods with native receiver and retain current immutable config snapshot. No RPC-client replacement or separate node/server.
officialRegistration.configuration: Explicit default-off startup option/environment translated once into validated fixed tier and resolved approved network/proof policy. Existing start_node returns nodeConfig; versions uses l1ChainId/rollupAddress/rollupVersion. Require concrete authorized canonical primitives; reject unresolved/missing scope, especially localNetwork path with config undefined unless explicitly validated startup scope supplied. Do not infer expected policy from a caller selector or turn an untrusted observed getNodeInfo into the trust configuration.
officialRegistration.exceptions: Adapter must contain fixed safe errors: extra middleware precedes official exceptionHandler, and outer jsonResponse formats thrown err.message. Do not let raw native/parser/cleanup errors escape.
officialRegistration.outerBoundary: No new main/admin listener, port or server lifecycle. Preserve default CORS/auth/version/health/RPC options. Native route rejects any Origin and accepts only fixed public selector; absent-Origin is not authentication. Existing deployment/main-listener admission remains explicit, not granted by this hook.

minimumPaths: One narrow hash/count-gated CLI registration transform module and its test (lead chooses path); no broad SDK server/platform patch.
requiredChecks: Keep existing35 tests for complete body/categories/root consumer validation/readiness/reorg/config receiver and abort-held native await. Replace source regex blanket setTimeout prohibition with explicit no-Promise.race/retry and behavioural lifetime tests.
Actual unfinished declared/chunked HTTP overflow yields bounded413/connection closure/no native calls; deterministic held-close both paths keeps second429 until closure.
Incomplete below-cap body and unfinished413response are terminated by existing admitted deadline; all listeners/timer cleaned.

Deferred original native call: client abort OR timer closes response, second429 remains until original settlement, no late success/further native queries, next explicit request allowed only after settlement.

Exact installed rc3 Koa/main middleware test: request raw stream not already parsed; valid compact route handled, unrelated RPC/version/health preserved; admin middleware unchanged, disabled config produces no route.
Pinned registration transform rejects unknown/multiple source matches, missing service and malformed scope; all native constructor captures immutable actual service receiver/config.
preservedBoundaries: Request1024bytes,response2MiB,field24575/header23,preflight all category/aggregate limits before flattening; canonical tier/header/readiness before and after.
No duplicate root computation in native server; downstream authenticateCompactBlock remains mandatory.
No broad early method/origin/busy rejection capacity claim; external connection admission remains separate.
Existing35 suite is historical context; no runtime acceptance for new repair or rc3 middleware until explicitly tested.
